A first Smart Police Station with digital reporting mechanisms was deployed in Gombe State by Galaxy Backbone with the Nigeria Police Trust Fund, reported on 11 June 2026.
The report of the Gombe Smart Police Station, deployed by Galaxy Backbone in partnership with the Nigeria Police Trust Fund, gives no cost and no source of funds (date is the report's).
